title: Ultragenyx Enters into Agreement to Sell Rare Pediatric
summary: NOVATO, Calif., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc. (NASDAQ: RARE) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) for $210 million. Ultragenyx received the PRV upon U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval of GENGLYCOS™ (pariglasgene brecaparvovec-opnr), also known as DTX401, the first treatment designed to address the underlying cause of glycogen storage disease type Ia (GSDIa).
